etc_reformulation_2026_09_04.goal: Reformulate the ETC fix to FORCE forward respiration (robustly), addressing the mcs-11 non-reproducibility.

formulations_tested.name: forward lower-bound only
formulations_tested.result: NO EFFECT — reverse rises to match forward (futile cycle); net stays reverse-hydrolysis, yield 0.815 at every forward-min (6..22).

formulations_tested.name: reverse=0 (net-forward, forward free)
formulations_tested.note: Robust respiration (0 infeasible) but yield BELOW band; ATP synthase bypassed (cell reroutes carbon to acetate).

formulations_tested.name: forward-min + reverse=0 (net-forward THROUGH ATP synthase)
formulations_tested.note: Yield reaches the band (0.41) ONLY at forward-min=12, where growth blows up to 1.48/h (vs physiological ~0.97) with non-physiological O2/acetate. Yield-in-band REQUIRES growth ~1.5.

etc_reformulation_2026_09_04.conclusion: No ATP-synthase FLUX BOUND simultaneously (a) forces respiration, (b) reproduces the measured biomass yield (0.355-0.444), and (c) preserves growth (~0.97/h). Forcing net-forward respiration is achievable and robust, but the yield band is only reachable by distorting growth. The defect is therefore STOICHIOMETRIC — the effective oxidative-phosphorylation P/O ratio (ATP made per O2 / per glucose) is mis-set — and the principled correction is a reaction-stoichiometry change (H+/ATP coupling, ETC proton pumping), NOT a flux bound. This precisely localizes the Arc-2 defect one level deeper than mcs-05.
